internal_policy.condition: Own committed hand SPELL frozen Fire face during the current global turn. Countered committed plays count; opponent, earlier turn, effect casts, summons, powers and uncommitted attempts do not. Native manual play uses its ordinary root target and the body reads the original RuleContext history; explicit independent paid/generated body profiles additionally retain their established original-input/current-recheck policies. No new timing window is introduced.
internal_policy.targets: IF_AVAILABLE all ordinarily targetable MINIONs on BOARD, either side. Without Fire or eligible target, targetless minion play remains legal. Manual source in HAND is not a board candidate; independent triggered Battlecry can target itself under ordinary body policies.
internal_policy.execution: Use existing ordinary Destroy after native Battlecry target validation. No additional payment, postpayment choice, custom RNG or death executor.
internal_policy.information: Sorted distinct known schools derived from existing PlayRecord frozen faces, own viewer only; no card identity/event/record/physical mapping added to DTO. Canonical original inputs and actual preceding records validate paid acceptance.
